# QR Code generator library

Project Nayuki, version 1.8.0, ES6 compiled release. MIT license is retained in the source header. The upstream file is unmodified.

Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/releases/download/v1.8.0/qrcodegen-v1.8.0-es6.js

Documentation: https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library

SHA-256: `6a1116192ed1dd67fa1bf31e77f5817103d71c23bbac24c382e698b7668bdd01`

Loaded locally; generating a QR code does not call an external QR service. Independent decode verification uses ZXing-C++ 3.1.1 as a test-only dependency.
